nom: TATCHA The Longevity Serum Skin Strength & Resilience Treatment

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or combo-dry skin (including one at 50 and one at 70) report strong moisturization and improved plumpness, though one 2-star review says it left her face tight and dry over time.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and rosacea-prone reviewers are split: several report no irritation and a gentle feel, but two describe redness, burning, or the need to wash it off.
segments.combination: A combination-to-dry reviewer in her 70s reports good moisturization and visible/felt improvement in skin.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (50s to 70s) most consistently report plumping, fewer fine lines, firmer and more youthful-looking skin.
segments.normal: Reviewers not specifying a skin issue mainly describe a lightweight, smooth, glowing finish with easy layering under moisturizer and makeup.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers targeting aging report fewer fine lines, improved firmness/elasticity, and a more youthful look within 2-3 weeks; a few say it's too soon to tell or notice no major anti-aging change.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe strong, all-day hydration and plumpness with no need for extra moisturizer; one reviewer reports the opposite, with tightness and dryness after use.
concerns.redness: One rosacea-prone reviewer found it safe and plumping on her skin; another with sensitive skin reports the serum turned her face red and made it feel like it was on fire.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers note it layers well and feels gentle/protective, especially post-derma-planing or alongside SPF and moisturizer.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report lighter dark marks/post-breakout marks and brighter, more even-looking skin after a few weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with breakout-prone skin reports fewer breakouts and improved texture; another mentions minor breakouts occurring with Tatcha products generally.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers state the serum leaves a glow without oiliness or greasiness, describing the finish as glowing rather than shiny.

aspects.libelle: Pairs well with other Tatcha products

extraits.titre: Made my skin feel tight and dry
extraits.texte: Serum smells pleasant and makes my skin look good. However, my face feels so tight, dry, and is uncomfortable after use. Following up with moisturizer helps slightly. I stopped using the serum for a few days and my skin felt better. Will not purchase again
My skin is very sensitive. This serum turned me very red in about 30 minutes and made it feel on fire. So I had to wash it off.

I initially tried the sample to see how my rosacea skin would react. It was safe my rosacea skin and it was nice and plumping. It feels healthy for my skin. I enjoy this serum, I don't know if i notice major changes in anti-aging, but it is a nice serum. I'm not sure if I would necessarily repurchase, it is a nice to have, not a necessary.

I just turned 70 and have combo to dry skin. The serum works well, makes my skin very moisturized, and works well with my other facial products. I can feel and see a difference. I have sinus allergies and can't take strong fragrances. The serum has a light fresh scent, doesn't aggravate my sinuses. Well worth the purchase.

I can't believe how my skin feels and looks. I have tried thousands of brands and by far TATCHA is the best! I saw results within 2weeks of consistently using their products. I followed the recommended rituals for what I was targeting which was pore refining, brightening dark spots under eyes and firmness. I'm 50 years old and have dry skin. I'm beyond satisfied.

This stuff really works! This stuff really works! I have really bad dark marks from my breakouts, and in the last 3 weeks I've been using this, they've gotten so much lighter. My skin feels so smooth and hydrated and healthy. Gifted by tatcha

Pleasantly surprised with this new serum as many anti-aging products have been irritating my skin including vitamin C. I have had no reactions and don't mind the scent. I prefer to smell the product than something overly fragranced. I'm looking forward to the benefits and ordering the cream.
